observation: Two basic propositional proofs were found automatically from fixed input-only selection rules, with no human-supplied proof trees. Their original certificates contain 1,273 and 2,068 primitive rows. Both complete cold runs passed separate original-byte checkers and independent whole-evidence reviews. This is a conventional proof-search baseline for the receptor-family study. The explicit archive includes every project Source guard and original actual; the external pinned Python runtime is identified in the plans and must be supplied separately.
next_step: Extract a small deterministic inventory from both admitted proof DAGs, then compare conventional conditional-lemma reuse with typed receptor-family reuse using the same acquired entries on the already frozen holdout. Preserve primitive fallback, retain an actual use map in the checked final proof, and charge acquisition, extraction, matching, checking and output costs. The holdout remains unsearched; GCTS and RL benefit remain to be demonstrated.
